Calls to Connection::RequestRouting and ::ReleaseRouting are moved from HttpRequest to Device. shill: Remove Connection from PortalDetector This patch removes Connection as a member variable in PortalDetector and instead makes Device and ConnectionDiagnostic pass either two lists of DNS addresses for IPv4 and IPv6, or a single list and an IP family to PortalDetector::StartAfterDelay when a portal detection trial is started. This prepares for making PortalDetector aware of layer 3 informations like DNS address list so that a single Trial can retry over different IP families on dual stack networks. Since the most likely place to pass the freshest layer 3 information is PortalDetector::StartAfterDelay(), this patch also consolidates into one function ::StartAfterDelay(), ::StartTrialAfterDelay(), and ::StartTrial(), and adds ::UpdateAttemptTime as well. This allows to avoid carrying the same arguments forward from one function to the next. shill: vpn: Stop overridding SetConnection CL:1748120 introduced a regression by triggering a latent infinite loop that was not previously reachable because the previous SetConnection override did not work as "intended". Ever since it was introduced in CL:22461, the VPNService::SetConnection override essentially behaved as if it wasn't there at all. Since Device::DestroyConnection calls Service::SetConnection(nullptr) prior to destroying the Connection instance, and since rebinding a Binder does *not* cause--nor has it ever caused--the client_disconnect_callback to be called, the Binder in VPNService::SetConnection was never bound to a Connection during the destruction of the Connection. This change simply removes the override of SetConnection, as the previous implementation essentially behaved as if that was the case.
